title: Fire & Explosion Response
description: Learn emergency identification, containment, and immediate suppression of industrial Class A, B, and C fires using standard factory PASS protocols and rapid evacuation maneuvers.
objectives: Identify the 4 fire classifications (Class A, B, C, D) found in industrial plants
Master the PASS Extinguisher Protocol (Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep)
Assess risk thresholds and determine when evacuation is mandatory
Execute automated gas-line cutoffs and electrical isolation procedures
